summary: legal checked in 5 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Risk disposition: conditional for ordinary measured growth; blocked for SearchWoot public launch. Compliance baseline passes 37/59, with 16 failures and 6 unknowns; data-quality contracts are green, but operations/security evidence is incomplete. Do not block ordinary growth solely for incomplete telemetry. Retain existing bounded workstreams only; no new monetization, claims, or site-level ROI assertions. Amazon revenue is $4.92 aggregate and unattributed; site-attributed income is $0, so revenue, margin, CAC, payback, and profitability remain unsupported. Recommendation: continue the six active reversible workstreams with existing measurement gates and keep SearchWoot private.

SearchWoot disposition: blocked. Concrete blockers are unresolved upstream rights for storage, derivatives, public display, caching, alerts, affiliate/advertising use, field attribution, freshness, correction, and takedown; incomplete data-flow, retention, deletion, processor, incident, consent, GA4, security, accuracy, attribution, and owner-decision evidence. Current public terms do not establish the required commercial/public-display rights. Exact decision: keep the site private and do not launch, monetize, expand notifications, alter tracking, or change production. Next evidence action: prepare, but do not send, a written permission request through the official provider process covering permitted fields, retention, display, alerts, attribution, freshness, correction, takedown, and commercial use; owner authorization is required before outreach.

Owner decision required: choose one concrete path—authorize preparation of an unsent provider-permission request, keep private with no outreach, or end the public-beta pursuit. No public beta or full launch is recommended while the launch-readiness decision rule remains unsatisfied.

Launch-readiness tracking progress: all four legal tasks remain open; none can be closed on current evidence. The source-rights task has authoritative documentation but no permission record. Data-flow, consent/analytics, and vendor/incident tasks have partial repository or policy evidence only. Next evidence actions are: produce the read-only data-flow and retention table; capture deployed consent and GA4 settings; produce the operator/vendor/log inventory; and record counsel-required gaps. Do not mark any task complete until evidence is attached and each data-use item has a final disposition.

Data-use review dispositions: Woot deal and price-history data—blocked pending written rights and field-level provenance, refresh/staleness, correction, and takedown evidence; smallest next action is prepare an unsent provider-permission request. User alert rules and sync results—evidence_needed pending data inventory, retention/deletion/correction workflow, processor terms, notification consent, and unsubscribe evidence; smallest next action is produce a read-only data-flow/retention table. GA4 analytics—conditional for measurement-only use if consent-gated; evidence_needed for deployed consent/withdrawal behavior, GA4 sharing and retention settings, vendor disclosure, and jurisdiction review; smallest next action is capture current configuration without enabling tracking. Operational logs and Cloudflare hosting data—evidence_needed pending log-field inventory, retention/access controls, vendor terms or DPA review, and incident/request procedures; smallest next action is produce the read-only operator/vendor inventory. Any future affiliate, advertising, remarketing, or customer matching use requires a new review; human counsel is required for unresolved rights, jurisdictional privacy, and commercial-use questions.
